request: why is a² − b² equal to (a + b)(a − b)?

beats.narration: Start with a square of side a, here five. Its area is a squared.
beats.code:
stage.title("Difference of two squares")
u = 0.7
o = np.array([-5.5, -2.0, 0])
big = Square(5 * u, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.4).move_to(o + np.array([2.5 * u, 2.5 * u, 0]))
stage.play(Create(big))
stage.add(big)
la1 = stage.label(Line(o, o + 5 * u * RIGHT), "a", direction=DOWN)
la2 = stage.label(Line(o, o + 5 * u * UP), "a", direction=LEFT)

beats.intent: A b by b square, b = 2, cut from the top right corner, leaving an L shape of area a² − b²
beats.narration: Cut a smaller square of side b, here two, out of the corner. What's left has area a squared minus b squared.
beats.code:
small = Square(2 * u, color=RED, fill_opacity=0.6).move_to(o + np.array([4 * u, 4 * u, 0]))
stage.play(FadeIn(small))
bottom = Rectangle(width=5 * u, height=3 * u, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.4).move_to(o + np.array([2.5 * u, 1.5 * u, 0]))
strip = Rectangle(width=3 * u, height=2 * u, color=GREEN, fill_opacity=0.5).move_to(o + np.array([1.5 * u, 4 * u, 0]))
stage.play(FadeOut(small, shift=UR), FadeOut(big), FadeIn(bottom), FadeIn(strip))
stage.add(bottom, strip)
lab = stage.label(Line(o + 5 * u * RIGHT, o + 5 * u * RIGHT + 3 * u * UP), "a − b", direction=RIGHT)

beats.intent: The top strip turned and slid to the right end, making one rectangle a + b long and a − b tall
beats.narration: Turn the top strip on its side and slide it to the end. Now it's one rectangle: a plus b long and a minus b tall.
beats.code:
stage.play(FadeOut(la1), FadeOut(la2), FadeOut(lab))
stage.play(strip.animate.rotate(-PI / 2).move_to(o + np.array([6 * u, 1.5 * u, 0])), run_time=1.5)
stage.add(strip)
stage.label(Line(o + 7 * u * RIGHT, o + 7 * u * RIGHT + 3 * u * UP), "a − b", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)
stage.label(Line(o, o + 7 * u * RIGHT), "a + b", direction=DOWN, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: The rectangle beside a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b), and 25 − 4 = 7 × 3 = 21
beats.narration: Same area, rearranged: a squared minus b squared is a plus b times a minus b. With five and two, twenty five minus four is seven times three, twenty one.

request: how many euros do you get for £50 at 1.15 euros to the pound?

beats.intent: Two lined-up number lines, pounds above and euros below, £1 matched to €1.15
beats.narration: Put pounds on one line and euros on another, lined up so that one pound sits above one euro fifteen.
beats.code:
stage.title("Changing pounds to euros")
gbp = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 50, 10], length=10).move_to([0, 0.8, 0])
eur = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 57.5, 11.5], length=10).move_to([0, -0.8, 0])
stage.play(Create(gbp), Create(eur))
stage.add(gbp, eur)
stage.play(FadeIn(Text("£", font_size=30).next_to(gbp, LEFT)), FadeIn(Text("€", font_size=30).next_to(eur, LEFT)))
one = DashedLine(gbp.n2p(1), eur.n2p(1.15), color=YELLOW)
stage.play(Create(one), FadeIn(Text("1", font_size=24, color=YELLOW).next_to(gbp.n2p(1), UP)), FadeIn(Text("1.15", font_size=24, color=YELLOW).next_to(eur.n2p(1.15), DOWN)))
stage.add(one)

beats.narration: Ten pounds is ten lots of one fifteen: eleven euros fifty.
beats.code:
ten = DashedLine(gbp.n2p(10), eur.n2p(11.5), color=GREEN)
stage.play(Create(ten), FadeIn(Text("10", font_size=24, color=GREEN).next_to(gbp.n2p(10), UP)), FadeIn(Text("11.50", font_size=24, color=GREEN).next_to(eur.n2p(11.5), DOWN)))
stage.add(ten)

beats.intent: £50 matched to €57.50 at the far end
beats.narration: Fifty pounds is five lots of that: fifty seven euros fifty.
beats.code:
fifty = DashedLine(gbp.n2p(50), eur.n2p(57.5), color=ORANGE)
stage.play(Create(fifty), FadeIn(Text("50", font_size=24, color=ORANGE).next_to(gbp.n2p(50), UP)), FadeIn(Text("57.50", font_size=24, color=ORANGE).next_to(eur.n2p(57.5), DOWN)))
stage.add(fifty)

beats.narration: Going to euros, multiply by one point one five. Coming back, divide by it.

request: how does the height of a seat on a Ferris wheel change as it turns?

beats.intent: A Ferris wheel of radius 10 m with its centre 12 m up, a seat at the bottom 2 m above the ground
beats.narration: A Ferris wheel has radius ten metres, its centre twelve metres up. You get on at the bottom, two metres above the ground.
beats.code:
stage.title("Riding a Ferris wheel")
k = 0.2
ground_y = -2.6
c = np.array([-4.4, ground_y + 12 * k, 0])
wheel = VGroup(Circle(radius=10 * k, color=WHITE).move_to(c), *[Line(c, c + 10 * k * np.array([np.cos(a), np.sin(a), 0]), color=GREY_B, stroke_width=2) for a in np.arange(0, TAU, TAU / 8)])
ground = Line([-6.8, ground_y, 0], [3.4, ground_y, 0], color=GREY_B)
seat = Dot(c + 10 * k * DOWN, color=YELLOW, radius=0.14)
stage.play(Create(ground), Create(wheel), FadeIn(seat))
stage.add(ground, wheel, seat)
stage.label(seat, "2 m", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: The seat going once round in 60 s while its height is drawn against time on axes beside the wheel
beats.narration: The wheel turns once a minute. Plot the seat's height against time as it goes round: up to the top, and back down.
beats.code:
ax = Axes(x_range=[0, 60, 15], y_range=[0, 24, 6], x_length=4.2, y_length=24 * k, axis_config={"include_numbers": True, "font_size": 20}, tips=False)
ax.shift(np.array([-1.2, ground_y, 0]) - ax.c2p(0, 0))
stage.play(Create(ax))
stage.add(ax)
curve = ax.plot(lambda t: 12 - 10 * np.cos(TAU * t / 60), x_range=[0, 60], color=YELLOW)
stage.play(Rotate(seat, angle=TAU, about_point=c, rate_func=linear), Create(curve, rate_func=linear), run_time=4)
stage.add(seat, curve)

beats.intent: Dashed lines from the top of the wheel to the graph's peak: 22 m at 30 s
beats.narration: Halfway round, at thirty seconds, you're at the top: twelve plus ten, twenty two metres.
beats.code:
top = DashedLine(c + 10 * k * UP, ax.c2p(30, 22), color=ORANGE)
stage.play(Create(top))
stage.add(top)
peak = Dot(ax.c2p(30, 22), color=ORANGE)
stage.play(FadeIn(peak))
stage.add(peak)
stage.label(peak, "22 m at 30 s", direction=UP, color=ORANGE)

beats.intent: The picture beside h = 12 − 10 cos(6t°) and h(30) = 22
beats.narration: The height is twelve minus ten times the cosine of six t degrees, since the wheel turns six degrees each second.

request: what is the area of a 90° sector of a circle with radius 4?

beats.intent: A circle of radius 4 with its area, π × 4² ≈ 50.3
beats.narration: A circle of radius four has area pi times four squared, about fifty square units.
beats.code:
stage.title("Area of a sector")
c = np.array([-3, -0.3, 0])
circle = Circle(radius=2.2, color=WHITE, fill_color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.15).move_to(c)
rad = Line(c, c + 2.2 * RIGHT, color=BLUE)
stage.play(Create(circle), Create(rad))
stage.add(circle, rad)
stage.label(rad, "4", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)
stage.label(circle, "π × 4² ≈ 50.3", direction=UP)

beats.intent: A 90° sector shaded, its right angle marked
beats.narration: Shade a ninety degree slice: a quarter turn.
beats.code:
sector = AnnularSector(inner_radius=0, outer_radius=2.2, angle=PI / 2, start_angle=0, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.6).move_arc_center_to(c)
stage.play(FadeIn(sector))
stage.add(sector)
mark = VGroup(Line(c + 0.3 * RIGHT, c + 0.3 * RIGHT + 0.3 * UP), Line(c + 0.3 * UP, c + 0.3 * RIGHT + 0.3 * UP)).set_stroke(WHITE, 2)
stage.play(Create(mark))
stage.add(mark)

beats.intent: Four such sectors filling the circle, the others outlined
beats.narration: Four of these fill the whole circle, so the slice is a quarter of the area.
beats.code:
quarters = VGroup(*[AnnularSector(inner_radius=0, outer_radius=2.2, angle=PI / 2, start_angle=q * PI / 2, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0, stroke_width=2).move_arc_center_to(c) for q in range(1, 4)])
stage.play(Create(quarters))
stage.add(quarters)
stage.label(sector, "1/4 of 50.3 ≈ 12.6", direction=RIGHT, color=ORANGE)

beats.narration: Sector area is the fraction of the turn times the circle's area: a quarter of sixteen pi is four pi, about twelve point six.
